Alex: afternoon async check — quick standup for gateway routing / rate limits work

Alex: yesterday: pushed rate-policy v2 to staging and validated header propagation for 80% of routes
Derrick: noticed a short spike of 429s ~04:15 UTC after the push, maybe batching timeout drift
Alex: yeah saw that in traces; reverted the batching timeout on canary to previous value
Rachel: blocker: I need prod creds to exercise the new routing override, opened infra ticket but waiting on approval
Jamie: I can stand up a temp test key if infra approves — @Sophia any objections? :eyes:
infra-bot: Ticket created TKT-4123 for secret request. Reviewer: @Sophia. Status: pending_approval
Sophia: approved the ticket, Jamie — use `secrets://gateway/prod` with ephemeral access, expires in 6h
Jamie: thanks, grabbed creds and ran basic smoke. No routing mismatches in staging. Uploaded test config: configs/routing/agency-policy.yaml
Alex: plan for today: roll canary to 20% at 13:00 PT, monitor 5m lat, error-rate, and 429s. If 429s > 1% rollback immediately
Derrick: will add a short alert script to post to this channel when 5m 429-rate exceeds threshold
Derrick: script snippet:```bash
#!/bin/bash
err=$(curl -s "http://metrics/api?q=error_rate&route=policy-v2" | jq -r .value)
if (( $(echo "$err > 0.01" | bc -l) )); then
  curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data '{"text":"ALERT: policy-v2 429-rate >1%"}' https://hooks.slack.com/services/T/CH/WEBHOOK
fi
```
Jamie: quick note — I opened PR 782 for the small infra refactor (adds metric tag). Asking @Rachel for review. Link: https://git/repo/pull/782
Rachel: will review today, aim to merge before canary roll. Focus on comments around tag naming
Alex: also adding a short smoke test to the canary job to ensure KV cache warmup completes within 300ms
Sophia: FYI I'm scheduling a brief maintenance window for the secrets rotation later tonight, will notify if it overlaps the 13:00 window
Alex: ok thanks. If rotation overlaps, we delay canary by 30m.
Jamie: no other blockers from my side.
Derrick: I'll watch logs and slack alerts during the roll. ping me if anything odd, I can flip the policy flag fast.
Alex: great — cheers team. ping here for quick status updates during the roll. :rocket:
